submission.justification: Select Radiator-R3 at 3.75 cm because it gives the best simulated pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c among all evaluated eligible candidates and thicknesses: 4.869 sigma. All three candidates satisfy the documented 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing hard requirement, and R3 has documented transparency loss of 0%, below the 10% limit. The selected thickness is within the allowed 1–6 cm range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.
requirements.evidence: The best recorded simulated separation is for R3 at 3.75 cm: 4.869 sigma, higher than the best coarse R3 result at 2 cm (4.655 sigma), the best R2 result recorded (3.962 sigma at 3 cm), and the best R1 result recorded (2.973 sigma at 2 cm).

requirements.requirement: The radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Selected option is Radiator-R3; candidate_count = 3 and selected_candidate_id/final_candidate_id = 3.

requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after a 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test must not exceed 10%.
requirements.evidence: R3 documented/final humidity transparency loss is 0%, below the limit of 10%; no candidates were eliminated for documented loss.
Selected thickness is 3.75 cm, within the allowed range of 1–6 cm.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended radiator and thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Radiator-R3 at 3.75 cm.
